headline: Srinivasan Venkataramanan reports UVM-MS customer work and shares working-group feedback discussions
fact: In a June 17 public post, Srinivasan Venkataramanan reported that AsFigo's Ajeetha Kumari was deploying UVM-MS v1.0 on customer projects and had reviewed DVCon India papers from users of the standard. He shared a digest attributed to UVM-AMS working-group chair Evgeny Vlasov describing feedback from companies using v1.0 and proposals for driver/proxy/core communication while defining possible v2.0 scope. These are attributed reports of customer work and standards discussions, without named customers, independently verified adoption results or an issued v2.0 release. June 17 dates Venkataramanan's post, not the underlying meetings.
